description.value: On the Rocks is a pub and grill that bills itself as Kamloops' local favourite, serving an extensive menu that spans Maple-Glazed Salmon, AAA Prime Sterling Silver Sirloin, and hearty pub fare alongside a wide selection of draft and bottled beers from around the world. The venue doubles as an entertainment hub, with big-screen TVs for major sporting events and regular live music performances. Touring cyclists arriving in Kamloops would find a full sit-down meal option with a varied menu and a lively atmosphere.
